notes: Required engineering constraints derived from target architecture plus repository-backed factual inventory. They are not claimed to be automatically enforced until CI/release integration exists.

rules.rule: MasterProfile creation MUST NOT create a second Account.
SellerProfile creation MUST NOT create a second Account.
Authorization MUST use effective backend capabilities for the active Identity Context; compatibility role checks MUST NOT become a new authorization source.
Cross-context writes MUST go through the verified owner contract.
Each mutable business entity MUST resolve to one owner after factual inventory.
New business actions MUST NOT be added directly to api/db.php.
New frontend business code MUST NOT introduce direct fetches to legacy api/db.php.
A feature MUST NOT be promoted to READY without required evidence.
Legacy code MUST NOT be removed until replacement usage, data parity and regression safety are proven.
Agent MUST identify factual domain evidence, target owner and invariants before implementation.
Unverified ownership MUST be labeled TARGET_UNTIL_VERIFIED and MUST NOT be presented as canonical fact.

ServiceRequest and RepairOrder MUST remain distinct domain concepts even while the legacy physical model shares orders.id. No rename or physical split is allowed without an explicit compatibility/data-migration plan and regression coverage.
New Booking/Master scheduling code MUST NOT directly mutate Service-owned RepairOrder lifecycle fields. Scheduling changes to an accepted order require an explicit Service scheduling contract.
Garage owns vehicle state and vehicle_id child records; it MUST NOT own Service order lifecycle merely because orders reference client_vehicle_id.

Do not introduce another Organization membership/capability authority while organization_members permissions and Identity contexts/context_members/capability_sets overlap. New authorization must converge toward one backend authority.

While market_* and seller_* are both active, no third Product/Order/Stock source of truth may be introduced. Migration MUST inventory readers/writers and prove ID/data/command parity before retiring either model.

Finance ledger/invoice/transaction records and Service-linked operational financial projections MUST have explicit write authority. Payment flows that update both MUST remain transactional and reconciled; operational projections MUST NOT become an independent payment truth.
Internal KARETA chat/message state remains the conversation source of truth. Telegram/WhatsApp/provider delivery and inbound transport records MUST NOT become a second canonical message store.
Do not introduce a new social reaction/comment store while work_post_* and master_wall_* interaction stores overlap. Canonical social interaction ownership must be selected before consolidation.

domain_entities/domain_relations/domain_events are integration/projection infrastructure and MUST NOT be treated as the business aggregate owner or used to bypass the owning bounded-context command contract.
